import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix label variants
    df["species"] = df["species"].replace({"Gentto": "Gentoo", "Adeile": "Adelie"})
    df["island"] = df["island"].str.title()
    
    # Convert text numbers to integers (remove commas)
    df["body_mass_g"] = df["body_mass_g"].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    df["flipper_length_mm"] = df["flipper_length_mm"].astype(int)
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species', as_index=False)['body_mass_g'].mean()
    
    # Convert to dict with species as key and average body mass as value
    return {row['species']: round(row['body_mass_g']) for _, row in result.iterrows()}
